text:
zach: quick idea — can the gateway do header-based affinity so we pin tenant traffic to the same serving shard? thinking `X-Tenant-Affinity` map -> shard. If header missing, fall back to auth claim, then to UA hash. avoids a redis lookup per request if the header is present.

ida: seems sane. what's the failure mode if the header is spoofed?

zach: good call. proposal includes validated signed header for dedicated customers (HMAC with shared key), else gateway should ignore for public customers and use auth.sub fallback.

mike: prefer auth.sub as default fallback rather than UA. UA can be noisy and lead to bad spreads. also UA changes with client versions.

sophia: +1 on auth.sub. also we should consider cookie affinity for browsers (session cookie -> shard) so SDKs don't need to pass header.

zach: agreed on cookie for browser flows. here's a rough policy sketch — would love feedback on shape and edge cases:

```yaml
route: /v1/*
affinity:
  primary: 
    type: header
    name: X-Tenant-Affinity
    validate: hmac
    key_id_header: X-Affinity-Key
  fallback_priority:
    - type: auth_claim
      claim: sub
    - type: header
      name: X-Org-ID
    - type: hash_header
      name: User-Agent
  browser_cookie: __rw_affinity
  ttl: 300 # seconds
```

ida: minor nit — where do we resolve key_id_header -> key material? gateway config or KMS? if we require gw to have keys it complicates private deploy.

mike: put key lookup into control plane (private deployments can opt in to sync local key cache). gateway validates with local cache, control plane rotates keys. avoids per-request KMS calls.

sophia: what about ingress ordering? we need to decide if edge LB should rewrite/strip headers. if edge accepts raw X-Tenant-Affinity we risk tenant impersonation unless signed. Recommend edge strips unsigned headers unless a signed marker present.

zach: agree. add `X-Affinity-Signature` and `X-Affinity-Key`. unsigned headers are logged and discarded.

sre-bot: note — rolling this out will affect routing metrics. create a dashboard for "affinity-misses" and "affinity-fallbacks" per region/shard.

ops-bot: FYI deploying header-affinity policy will require a migration plan: 1) enable validation-only mode (log rejects), 2) enable signed header acceptance, 3) flip to enforce.

mike: +1 on validation-only. we should also have a TTL-based eviction so stale header->shard mappings don't hold forever.

ida: one more thought — rate limits and quota attribution: if we route by header, ensure billing attribution still uses auth.sub when present (don't mix up header identity vs billed identity).

zach: good catch. billing must use auth token claims, not header. I'll add that to the policy and the checklist for rollout.

sophia: example checklist item to add: "edge must strip X-Tenant-Affinity unless signature verified by gateway" and "console shows per-shard heatmap + fallback rate".

zach: ok I'll draft a PR with the config and a minimal dashboard. thanks team. :thumbsup:
